defs.def: a person whose job is to prepare and sell medicines, and who works in a shop 药剂师；药商
a shop/store that sells medicines and usually also soap, make-up, etc. 药房；（通常也出售肥皂、化妆品等的）药店
a scientist who studies chemistry 化学家

ex.s: Moore physicist mathematician chemist astronomer geographer biologist 1 What do you know about these careers?
ex.t: 摩尔　物理学家　数学家　化学家　天文学家　地理学家　生物学家　1 你对这些职业了解多少？

ex.s: They said that Carson did not understand the science behind her arguments because she was a marine biologist rather than a chemist.
ex.t: 他们说，卡森不理解她论点背后的科学，因为她是一位海洋生物学家，而非化学家。

ex.s: The chemist is doing an experiment.
So I want to become a chemist in the future.
ex.t: 所以我想未来成为一名化学家。

ex.s: Sometimes I wonder how relevant chemistry is to these students—few will ever become chemists—and most will be going back to their villages after Year 8 anyway.
ex.t: 有时我想知道化学对这些学生有多重要——很少有人会成为化学家——总之，大多数人会在 8 年级后回到自己的村庄。
